messages:
elaine: Quick note from canary: observed transient double-residency when demote+immediate prefetch overlap. Small spike in duplicate fetches (~600ms).
noah: Is this the metadata-less handoff path?
elaine: Yes. Origin demote async -> target prefetch -> origin clears; reordering caused both to hold residency briefly.
raj: Short-term fix: require origin to read a small persisted "pending" marker before clearing. Use consensus store for the marker.
noah: Concern: extra RTT on hot handoffs. Make it opt-in per-prefix when contention heuristics trigger.
elaine: Heuristic: if concurrent prefetch attempts >1 in 1s or tenant-hot flag, flip to safe path. Also TTL pending=30s.
raj: Add metrics: handoff_path{fast|safe}, handoff_conflicts, pending_ttl_expirations.
noah: Tests: chaos job to reorder RPCs and delay final clear. I'll add a simple harness.
infra-bot: deploy-plan created: `prefetch-handshake-ttl` -> canary: redwood-canary-2 -> rollout: 10/30/60. Link: https://deploys/internal/prefetch-handshake-ttl
elaine: Owners: Noah=test+impl, Raj=metadata API+migrations, I'll write RFC follow-up and dashboards. Will post canary results here. :thumbsup:
